source.quote: Non-GAAP basis: $2.01 exceeded guidance of $1.65 to $1.80.
The Company did not make any common stock repurchases under the stock repurchase program during the first quarter of 2026.

source.section: PVH Corp. Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend (companion same-period 8-K)
source.quote: declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.0375 per share payable on June 24, 2026 to stockholders of record on June 3, 2026

extendedMetrics.label: Sale of assets (pre-tax gain, Q2 recognition)

source.quote: will record a pre-tax gain of $25 million in the second quarter of 2026 in connection with the sale of its owned warehouse and distribution center located in Jonesville, NC
Projected to decrease 3% to 4% compared to the second quarter of 2025
Projected to be in a range of $3.00 to $3.10 on a non-GAAP basis

source.section: Reconciliations of Constant Currency Revenue (derived: Owned and Operated Digital Commerce $170.1M ÷ Total Revenue $2,025.1M)
source.quote: Owned and Operated Digital Commerce revenue increased 11% compared to the prior year period
